chunks: And from him, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā, from Saʿīd ibn Yasār, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a woman who menstruates, then becomes pure, and perhaps after that sees some thin blood after her ghusl from her purity. He said: “She should exercise precaution after her [usual] days by two or three days, then perform salat (prayer).”

key_terms.تَسْتَظْهِرُ: she acts with precaution by waiting extra days

ai.seo_question: What should a woman do if she sees light blood after ghusl following menstruation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning a woman who sees slight blood after becoming pure from menstruation and performing ghusl. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructs that she should wait an additional two or three days beyond her usual menstrual days as a precaution, and then perform salat (prayer).
